theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_wn_removeNth_fiber_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (i₀ : Fin P) (F : (Fin k → Fin P) → ℝ), ∑ j : Fin (k + 1) → Fin P, ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (if j i = i₀ then F (i.removeNth j) else 0) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ∑ j' : Fin k → Fin P, F j'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
